policy.description: Blocking line-coverage ratchets. For a fixed scope, coveredLines is the highest value in the reviewed clean-run observation envelope, never a modal or repeated lower value, and that high-water never decreases. Update the envelope in the same reviewed change whenever scope or coverage advances. A fixed-scope floor may move downward only to the exact minimum directly observed by clean runs on the identical source, tests, and total-line scope, with linked evidence and a bounded tolerance; unexplained coverage loss remains a regression.

tolerance.rationale: Document retirement tests exercise the shared routed-page owner through native-shaped page transitions, stale mutation/navigation callbacks, and restored authentication/configuration boundaries. Two clean full client runs at Canopy commit ed65e34a6c7115eeababa20196503905736e965f passed all 2,642 tests across 275 files and both measured 2,984/3,362 core lines (88.757%). The 578 recorded client source/test/configuration inputs and complete JSON summaries are identical between runs. Core production source and total-line scope are unchanged; the existing dom-observer owner advances from 166/200 to 174/200 covered lines, with every other core file retaining its prior line count. The observed high-water and exact floor therefore advance from 2,976 to 2,984 lines, with zero instrumentation tolerance. Raw logs and per-file summaries are retained privately. coverage-baseline.test.js rejects the immediately lower count, higher unreviewed count, and either neighboring scope; policy and server baseline are unchanged.

Canonical Series relationship-string reuse changes the complete assembly scope from 57,155 to 57,163 instrumented lines. The accompanying paused-handoff regression owns its dedicated producer thread and observes queue admission separately from thread startup, preserving the original one-second admission deadline and losslessness checks. Two clean local full runs on the identical 601-file production/test/build-input scope at Canopy commit aa6105355e6d13dfbb3ff9fba8bc981c6182b255, using SDK 10.0.302/runtime 10.0.10, each passed all 4,716 tests and measured 47,256/57,163 and 47,254/57,163. Both raw Cobertura reports and full logs are retained, with identical class/file/line keys and verified source hashes after the main update. A third clean hosted run on the identical 601 source/build inputs at Canopy synthetic merge 2c0af3ee9c337464bdfdd3341e08d496180f598b, using SDK 10.0.400/runtime 10.0.11, passed all 4,716 tests and measured 47,259/57,163. Its full job log and exact checkout/source hashes are retained; the job does not publish its XML, so the additional hosted line hits cannot be attributed individually. A fourth clean hosted run on the same 601 inputs at Canopy synthetic merge fcc31d5f959cfeb992a4d3153582cad33fc890f0, with the same hosted SDK/runtime, again passed all 4,716 tests and measured 47,261/57,163. Its raw log and source equivalence are retained with the same unavailable-XML attribution limit. A fifth clean hosted run on the same 601 inputs at merged Canopy commit 8408b2534958b557e5c94b3fc7f9c783a89a92bd, using SDK 10.0.400, passed all 4,716 tests and measured 47,263/57,163. Its retained post-merge job log and verified input hashes establish the new observation, with the same unavailable-XML attribution limit. These five observations establish high-water 47,263, unchanged directly observed floor 47,254, and exactly nine lines of tolerance (about 0.0157 percentage points). TagCacheDependencyGraph coverage advances from 242/270 to 258/277 and TagCacheService from 1,847/1,938 to 1,849/1,939; both changed owners have identical coverage in the two new runs. In the local pair, six differing Boolean line hits in existing PlatformProviderInvocationService and PlatformProviderRegistryOrchestrator lifecycle branches produce the two-line net spread. The local pair loses no changed-owner coverage, and no failing-test or different-source measurement is included. The policy, client baseline, coverage implementation, original worker-allocation budgets and queue-admission deadline remain unchanged. coverage-baseline.test.js rejects 47,253, requires review above 47,263, and rejects either neighboring total-line scope or an unevidenced broader envelope.
